summary: Scope refresh at 44fca100 confirms the coupled capture→reduce→persist→analyze→query Jenkins operational-insights pipeline remains production-grade. Environment delta since 0766c0a2 is api-v1.md metadata subfield documentation only; Java runtime modules, entrypoints, and coupling are unchanged. Roughly 3,220 LOC across 26 core modules compile via bin/build-core; InsightsRuntime orchestrates HomeSources, ReconciliationEngine, EventJournal, GenerationStore, AnalysisEngine, and QueryService with Jenkins bindings in OperationalInsightsPlugin. Starter wiring gaps remain minor scaffolding rather than dominant padding.

evidence.observation: Lifecycle owner wires recovery, full reconcile, incremental drain, query, compact, and multi-component health—unchanged production orchestration core.
Only environment delta vs prior Q6 scope: metadata subfield documentation added; no Java or runtime behavior change.
Primary operator entrypoint unchanged: build-core then InsightsMain dispatch for all documented commands.
Pinned build, generate 14,536 records, reconcile seed at image bake; substantive production surface unchanged.

findings.criterion: Unreachable solver-visible modules should not materially inflate production scale claims
findings.why_it_matters: SnapshotDiff has no callers; minor scaffolding overstates immediately reachable logic.
findings.minimal_remediation: Wire into reconcile diagnostics or remove until needed.

findings.criterion: Retention/compaction planners should affect operator behavior when invoked
findings.why_it_matters: compact() constructs RetentionPlanner plan but deletes by simple oldest-N index.
findings.minimal_remediation: Apply RetentionPlanner.removable list when deleting generation directories.

standalone core build exclusion of jenkins/* in bin/build-core
